description: Get the deployed smart contract addresses for Orderly on a specific chain and network. `chain` is required; `contractType` filters to one contract (e.g. vault, usdc, usdt) or 'all'; `network` selects mainnet (default) or testnet. 'all' lists every contract with an address on the selected network; a specific type also returns its description and the address on the other network when available. Unknown chains or contract types return the valid options. Read-only lookup from bundled data — no network calls, credentials, or side effects. Use for deployment and wiring addresses only; for API details use get_api_info or the matching named API tool, for SDK symbols use search_orderly_docs, and for integration steps use explain_workflow.

contractType.description: Contract type (e.g., 'vault', 'usdc', 'usdt') or 'all' for all contracts

name: get_contract_addresses
